capabilities: export a selected note as an HTML file to the NotesOn.ru server
publish a note via a right-click context menu command
copy the public URL of the published note to the clipboard
remove a published note from the NotesOn server
extras: README is short and uses non-native English; publishing is tied to a single third-party server (NotesOn.ru), so notes go to that service rather than self-hosting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to instantly put one note on the web and get a shareable public URL for it.
summary: Publishing plugin that exports a single note as an HTML file to the NotesOn.ru server and gives you a public link to share.
